proves.claim: With the board held busy, pullboard mark exits 0, writes no event and appends one spool line carrying the mark's original at.

cli.mark.spool-when-busy.why: Without it, a mark made while the board is busy or restarting is lost or blocks its caller, and the time becomes UNACCOUNTED.

proves.claim: The next mark that writes first replays the spooled mark with its original at, then writes its own, and empties the spool.

cli.mark.replay-original-at.why: Without it, a spooled mark would never reach the item's timeline, or would land at the replay time instead of the time it names.

proves.claim: A spool replayed twice, with a crash after the first write, yields exactly one row per mark.

cli.mark.replay-no-double.why: Without it, a replay that died halfway would write its first mark twice on the next attempt.
